description: A local-first memory and learning system for AI coding agents, with an MCP server for Claude Code.
releaseNotes: 0.10.0 makes AgentRecall visibly useful and its state queryable. Activity Notices surface what it fetched, captured, skipped, resolved, mined, and recommended through a recognizable badge — kept separate from the model-visible context so verbose detail never inflates injected tokens — with `agentrecall activity last|list` and configurable ActivityNoticeLevel/HookNoticeLevel. The generated CLAUDE.md now carries an explicit behavior contract that routes capture/state questions to the existing status commands and forbids speculative non-answers. Full notes: https://github.com/AkbarDizaji/AgentRecall/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
title: AgentRecall
